profile.draft: locked-v3 plus one independently learned override
profile.supportSplits: serving planner after actual funding; complete independent spellbooks
profile.placement: actual final A19 placement before barrels

design.independentUnit: offer board; training averages one draft assignment over two physical seats; qualification/confirmation average both assignments and both seats
design.balance: all 16 synergy combinations x three ranked maps x nine doctrine pairs x ordinary/pressure opponent; five train decision levels
design.opponentPopulation: half current locked V3, half preserved legal pressure draft with funded movement plan
design.trainingSmoke: reused first train board in each target phase; full local/node outcomes and traces must match; no extra independent evidence

training.recipeSelection: mean counterfactual gain on whole-board internal split; ties retain earlier registered recipe
training.finalFit: refit selected recipe once on all 4320 training boards before independent qualification

gates.overall: gain >=1 pp with positive family-adjusted interval against both current and locked references
gates.populations: nonnegative means and family-adjusted lower bound >= -1 pp against both references in each population
gates.mapsAndDoctrines: no map or candidate-doctrine mean below -1 pp against either reference
gates.ablation: prespecified secondary diagnostic, nominal 95% interval; do not claim causal context gain without positive interval
gates.timing: mean full-fight and own decision time ratios <=1.10 against both references, then independent alternating serial timing on reused qualification boards
gates.confirmation: only unchanged finalists after qualification passes; never replace after opening either bank

scannedChannelDerivation: For every preimage p, exclude p+i and permuteRankedDraftSeed(p+i), i=0..7. All 2006656 expanded channels are disjoint from the 5226607 prior numeric values.
